requirement.description: Authentication and HTTP response handling issue in WebDAV operations
requirement.contract: The HttpCli.handle_propfind method should properly return HTTP 401 Unauthorized responses with correct WWW-Authenticate headers when authentication fails, rather than returning HTML content with text/html content-type. Expected behavior: When a client makes a WebDAV request without proper authentication, it should return HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized with WWW-Authenticate header, not HTML content.

requirement.description: Directory key-based thumbnail generation with proper permission checking
requirement.contract: The HttpCli.handle_get method should properly validate directory keys when generating thumbnails and return appropriate HTTP 403 Forbidden responses when access is denied, rather than returning default thumbnail content. Expected behavior: When accessing a directory with a valid key but insufficient permissions, it should return HTTP 403 with "e403" text in the SVG response, not "folder".

requirement.description: Copy operation path resolution and deduplication logic
requirement.contract: The HttpCli.handle_post method should correctly resolve file paths during copy operations and maintain proper file hierarchies when deduplicating files, ensuring that all expected file paths are correctly listed in PROPFIND responses. Expected behavior: Copy operations should properly resolve paths and maintain the correct file hierarchy, ensuring that all files are accessible via the expected paths.
